description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying its mana cost.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Fabrication Module triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat from step 3.
